title: Voi cânta bunătatea Ta (Revive)
source: Voi cânta bunătatea Ta Revive.mp3 (local file)
notes: Electric guitar part analysed from the demucs guitar stem: the electric mostly plays sustained, delay/reverb-washed chord voicings (ambient swells), so this is chord-based tab with the picking that the attacks on the record suggest, not a note-for-note lead transcription.
Form: Intro - Verse 1 - Verse 2 (drums enter) - Pre-chorus (quiet) - Verse 3 - Verse 4 - Chorus x2 - Tag - Bridge - Breakdown (guitar out) - Final chorus.
The bass walks a lot (F/C, F/A, Bb/D, C/E); the guitar stays on the plain shapes, only C/E is a real guitar voicing on the record.
notes_movable: Same part with no open strings: A-shape barre for F at the 8th fret, Am-shape Dm at 5, E-shape Bb at 6, E-shape C at 8. Keep the hand between frets 5 and 10.

swell.desc: Verses/intro: slow broken chord with everything ringing (big delay + reverb). Bass note on beat 1, then climb through the chord. p i m a = thumb index middle ring.

strum.desc: Choruses: full-chord strums. Count: 1 & 2 . 3 & 4 . a   ->   D D D . D D D . U  (push on the 'a' of 4 into the next bar).

hold.desc: Bridge/tag: one down-strum on the downbeat and let it ring; pick the top three strings on the '&' of 2; strum again on beat 4.

sections.name: Intro (0:03)
sections.note: Guitar alone with keys. Two bars of F, free tempo.

sections.name: Verse 1 (0:08)
sections.note: No drums yet. Each chord lasts two bars.

sections.name: Verse 2 (0:30)
sections.note: Drums enter at the end of the first F. Six bars, then the pre-chorus picks up the two F bars.

sections.name: Pre-chorus (0:46) - quiet
sections.note: Band drops out; guitar swells. Bar 5 splits F and C/E.

sections.name: Chorus 1 (1:55)
sections.note: Bar 3 splits F and C/E (bass walks down to E).

sections.name: Tag (2:38)
sections.note: Vocals and drums, guitar thins out to held chords.

sections.name: Bridge (2:48)
sections.note: Half-bar changes in bars 4, 6, 7, 8, 10. Guitar holds chords, bass does the walking.

sections.name: Breakdown (3:21) - guitar tacet
sections.note: Vocals + pad only; chords given for reference. Come back in on the next section.
